text.en:
Section 2 of Executive Order No. 429 dated 12 October 1990
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 2. REGION X, to be known as NORTHERN
MINDANAO, shall include the following provinces and cities:
Agusan del Norte
Agusan del Sur
Misatis Oriental
Surigao del Norte
Cagayan de Oro
The City of Cagayan de Oro shall serve as the regional

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 7th day of December, in the year
of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety.
By the President:
Executive Secretary
